title: P1: WebSocket timeout bug on Python 3.10 - wrong exception type caught
description:
File: python/src/lichen/dashboard/app.py
Line: 352-353

Bug: Code catches `TimeoutError` but `asyncio.wait_for()` raises `asyncio.TimeoutError`.

In Python 3.10, these are different exception types. Only in Python 3.11+ did `asyncio.TimeoutError` become an alias for `TimeoutError`.

The code requires Python 3.10+ (uses `X | Y` union syntax), so this bug affects Python 3.10 users.

Impact: On Python 3.10, WebSocket connections crash on timeout instead of receiving keep-alive pings. The exception propagates, falls through to `except Exception: break`, and the connection closes unexpectedly.

Fix: Catch `asyncio.TimeoutError` instead of `TimeoutError`, or catch both:
```python
except (TimeoutError, asyncio.TimeoutError):
    await websocket.send_text('{"event":"ping"}')
```
close_reason: Fixed by catching both TimeoutError and asyncio.TimeoutError at line 385 with noqa comment for ruff UP041
